title: Does ChatGPT enhance student learning? A systematic review and meta-analysis of experimental studies
authors: Ruiqi Deng; Maoli Jiang; Xinlu Yu; Yuyan Lu; Shasha Liu
text: Overall, ChatGPT improves academic performance, affective-motivational states, and higher-order thinking propensities; it reduces mental effort and has no significant effect on self-efficacy. Methodological limitations warrant cautious interpretation of results.
